summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Destiny 2 Boss Drops application. All backend APIs and frontend features are working correctly. The app successfully displays raid & dungeon loot tables with real Bungie manifest data, supports search/filtering, and implements localStorage-based checklist tracking.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/health returns 19 activities and 482 items
Backend: GET /api/stats returns correct counts (9 raids, 10 dungeons, 182 weapons, 300 armor, 17 exotics)
Backend: GET /api/filters returns elements, rarities, weapon types, classes
Backend: GET /api/activities with type filters (all/raid/dungeon)
Backend: GET /api/activities/vault_of_glass returns encounters with resolved items (icons, rarity, element)
Backend: 404 handling for invalid activities
Backend: GET /api/items search with filters (name, kind, rarity, element, pagination)
Backend: GET /api/items/{hash} returns item detail with sources
Backend: 404 handling for invalid items
Frontend: Home page loads with hero, stats (19/182/300/17), and 6 featured activity cards
Frontend: Activities page with working tabs (All: 19, Raids: 9, Dungeons: 10)
Frontend: Activity detail page (Vault of Glass) with banner, description, encounters, 40 loot items
Frontend: Item detail modal opens with icon, flavor text, rarity/element, sources, Mark Obtained and Favorite buttons
Frontend: Search page with search input (fatebringer: 4 results) and working filters (Type/Element/Rarity)
Frontend: Load more pagination (60 -> 120 items)
Frontend: Checklist page with overall progress bar and 19 activity progress cards
Frontend: Mark all obtained button (0/40 -> 40/40)
Frontend: Reset button (40/40 -> 0/40)
Frontend: Track/Obtained toggle on item cards updates header counter
Frontend: localStorage persistence verified (data persists across page reloads)
Frontend: Header navigation links work (Activities/Search/Checklist)
Frontend: Header global search navigates to /search?q=
Frontend: Armor Set section with class grouping (Hunter/Titan/Warlock)
Frontend: Additional Weapon Drops section present
Frontend: Real Bungie CDN images loading correctly (no broken images)
Frontend: Dark sci-fi aesthetic with starfield, hudgrid, vignette backgrounds
